## Vendor emails → VendorIQ
Vendors can simply email their documents to the onboarding inbox.

1. Email Trigger (IMAP) watches the inbox and downloads attachments (marks them read)
2. Code node packages sender, subject, body, SPF/DKIM and attachments; skips unrelated mail
3. VendorIQ sorts the attachments with document AI and builds a draft — or, if the subject carries `[VEN-…]`, treats it as a reply to an existing application

Uses an IMAP credential with the Gmail App Password (no Google Cloud OAuth needed).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ from: $json.from, subject: $json.subject, text: $json.text, message_id: $json.message_id, auth: $json.auth, attachments: $json.attachments }) }}
